Construction ERP Software for Singapore: QA/QC, BCA Compliance, and CONQUAS-Ready Quality Records

Singapore's construction sector runs on documentation. The Building and Construction Authority (BCA) expects rigorous quality systems, CONQUAS scoring rewards contractors who can prove workmanship, and main contractors flow ISO 9001 obligations down to every subcontractor. Generic construction ERPs handle costing; quality lives in spreadsheets and shared drives — until an audit or a CONQUAS assessment exposes the gaps. Atlantis ERP is an affordable, fully customizable ERP built on 30+ Odoo apps, designed by inspection professionals for companies where quality records are the product: builders, structural steel fabricators, QA/QC consultancies, and testing and inspection firms operating in Singapore.

Built for BCA-Regulated Projects

Projects under BCA oversight demand traceable inspection and test records: material certificates, welder qualifications, NDT reports on structural connections, and supervision records aligned with the Building Control Act framework. Atlantis ERP structures these as linked records against each project, block, and element — so when a BCA audit or a professional engineer's review arrives, the evidence trail is a query, not a week of collation.

CONQUAS Quality Scoring Support

CONQUAS rewards contractors who capture workmanship quality systematically — structural works, architectural works, and M&E installations all scored against defined standards. Atlantis ERP lets you mirror CONQUAS checklists as digital site inspection forms with photos, locations, and responsible parties, then track rectification to closure. Your internal quality data starts predicting your CONQUAS outcome instead of merely reacting to it, and the same records support Quality Mark and client-specific schemes.

Welding and NDT QA on Structural Steelwork

Structural steel is where construction QA meets NDT — and where Atlantis has unmatched depth. Welder qualification tracking, WPS/PQR management, weld maps, and UT/MT/PT inspection reports per AWS D1.1 and relevant SS/EN standards are native workflows, with technician certifications managed in the certification tracking module. If you subcontract NDT, capture their reports and certs in the same system; if you self-perform, see our NDT reporting software comparison and best NDT reporting software guide for how the reporting layer should work.

ISO 9001 Quality Management, Digitized

Most Singapore contractors hold ISO 9001 certification; few run it digitally. Atlantis ERP turns the paper QMS into workflows: document control with revisions and approvals, NCR management with root cause and corrective action tracking, supplier evaluations, calibration registers for site test equipment, and management review dashboards fed by live data. Surveillance audits become routine because the system is the quality record.

Project Costing and Progress Claims

Quality software that ignores money gets abandoned. Atlantis ERP includes full project costing: budgets by element and trade, committed costs from purchase orders, subcontractor claims, variation orders, and progress claim generation. Because costing and quality share one database, you can finally see rework cost by subcontractor and by defect category — the number that changes behavior on site.

Subcontractor Management

Singapore projects run on layered subcontracting. Atlantis ERP maintains a subcontractor register with BCA registration, bizSAFE status, insurance validity, and performance history; issues work orders with quality obligations attached; and routes their inspection requests, method statements, and test reports through structured approvals. Non-performing subcontractors surface in data, not in disputes.

Site Inspection Reports on Mobile

Site engineers and RTOs capture inspections on tablets: checklists, photo evidence, GPS-stamped locations, digital signatures. Requests for inspection route to consultants with due-date tracking; failed items open NCRs automatically. Everything syncs to the project record — no retyping, no lost forms, and reports render as clean PDFs for consultants and clients.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Atlantis ERP support CONQUAS assessment preparation?

Yes. CONQUAS-aligned checklists run as digital inspection forms with photos and rectification tracking, so your internal scores track the standard before assessors arrive. Checklists are fully customizable to current CONQUAS editions and client schemes.

Can it handle BCA and ISO 9001 audit documentation?

Yes. Inspection records, material certificates, welder and NDT technician qualifications, calibration records, and NCR histories are linked and exportable as audit packages in minutes.

We are a QA/QC consultancy, not a main contractor. Is it still a fit?

Absolutely — consultancies and inspection firms use Atlantis ERP for proposals, deployment scheduling, site reports, and invoicing in one system. It was designed by inspection professionals first.

Does it work on site with poor connectivity?

Yes — mobile capture works offline and syncs when coverage returns, which matters in basements, tunnels, and plant rooms.

How long does implementation take for a Singapore contractor?

Typical rollouts run in phased weeks — quality and site inspections first, costing and subcontractor modules next. We confirm a timeline with your tailored quote.
